title: Hearty Harmonious Chinese Poppy Seeds Char Siu Bao
description: A tangy and aerated Chinese dish featuring ground poppy seeds, this vegetarian-friendly Char Siu Bao is a comforting treat from the Yunnan region.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the flour, yeast, sugar, and salt.
Gradually add in the vegetable oil and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Let the dough rise in a warm place for 1 hour.
In a separate bowl, mix together the ground poppy seeds, chopped scallions, and soy sauce.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces and roll each piece into a ball.
Flatten each ball into a disk shape and place a tablespoon of the poppy seed mixture in the center.
Fold the dough over the filling and seal the edges.
Steam the buns over boiling water for 15 minutes.
Serve the buns warm and enjoy.
